evidence: Pinned vendor application images; byte-checked reachable GNU CFGs and exact initialized-pointer reference scans. Function roles are analytical descriptions.
limits: The main candidate regions are an inventory boundary, not a claim that all vendor code lies contiguously there; eight identified outlying application helpers per build are recorded separately.
A complete selected CFG is not semantic equivalence, exhaustive execution coverage, proof of all dynamic targets or a complete SDK/ROM/hardware analysis.
The 64 roots per build lacking a direct in-region caller each have a pointer word and identified use; reference existence does not prove runtime registration or execution.
The function table contains no vendor instruction bytes, decompiled source, firmware payloads, credentials or assets.
